// Overlaid into the original CPAMP usagehistory package by TestGenerateRealOracle.
// It opens the caller's scratch copy of the real backup as-is: the original Init
// runs, but no fixture rows are inserted. The fixed pin is used verbatim as the
// original ProfileFilter, and every case is derived from the original outputs
// themselves (sorted, de-duplicated, then capped). Nothing here prints row data.
package usagehistory

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/seakee/cpa-manager-plus/apps/manager-server/internal/store"
)

// Caps are recorded in real-boundary.json so a capped oracle is never mistaken
// for an exhaustive one.
const (
	realProfileCap      = 20
	realAccountCap      = 20
	realProfileProofCap = 300
	realProofCap        = 100
	realForecastCap     = 50
)

// realOracleCase has the same layout as the synthetic historical-oracle.json.
type realOracleCase struct {
	Name, View, Window, Kind string
	Filter                   ProfileFilter
	Quota                    *QuotaUsageFilter `json:",omitempty"`
	Output                   json.RawMessage
}

// realCoverage is how many distinct ids one capped view named (found) and how
// many survived its cap (kept). found > kept means the view was truncated.
type realCoverage struct {
	Found int `json:"found"`
	Kept  int `json:"kept"`
}

// realSelect keeps non-empty unique ids in ascending order and applies the cap,
// returning the kept ids and how many distinct ids were found before the cap.
func realSelect(ids []string, limit int) ([]string, realCoverage) {
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	out := []string{}
	for _, id := range ids {
		if id != "" && !seen[id] {
			seen[id] = true
			out = append(out, id)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	found := len(out)
	if len(out) > limit {
		out = out[:limit]
	}
	return out, realCoverage{Found: found, Kept: len(out)}
}

func TestPacerRealServiceOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out, db, pinPath := os.Getenv("PACER_REAL_ORACLE_OUT"), os.Getenv("PACER_REAL_DB"), os.Getenv("PACER_REAL_PIN")
	if out == "" || db == "" || pinPath == "" {
		t.Fatal("explicit output, scratch DB and pin required")
	}
	pinBytes, e := os.ReadFile(pinPath)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	// Strict decoding: an unknown pin key is a configuration error, not a no-op.
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(pinBytes))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var base ProfileFilter
	if e = dec.Decode(&base); e != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid pin")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	st, e := store.Open(db)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	defer st.Close()
	s := New(st, nil)
	if e = s.Init(ctx); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}

	var cases []realOracleCase
	add := func(c realOracleCase, v any) {
		c.Output = encode(v)
		cases = append(cases, c)
	}

	// coverage is keyed like caps. Every capped view records an entry, even when
	// it found no ids, so the parity gate can tell "nothing found" from "not recorded".
	coverage := map[string]realCoverage{}
	keep := func(view string, ids []string, limit int) []string {
		kept, cov := realSelect(ids, limit)
		coverage[view] = cov
		return kept
	}

	// Base profiles report; its ids drive every other profile/account/window case.
	profiles, e := s.ProfileReport(ctx, base)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	add(realOracleCase{Name: "base", View: "profiles", Filter: base}, profiles)
	var cardIDs, credentialIDs, profileWindowIDs []string
	for _, c := range profiles.Cards {
		cardIDs = append(cardIDs, c.ID)
	}
	for _, c := range profiles.Credentials {
		credentialIDs = append(credentialIDs, c.ID)
	}
	for _, w := range profiles.Windows {
		profileWindowIDs = append(profileWindowIDs, w.ID)
	}
	accountIDs := keep("accounts", credentialIDs, realAccountCap)
	for _, id := range keep("profiles", cardIDs, realProfileCap) {
		f := base
		f.Profile = id
		r, e := s.ProfileReport(ctx, f)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("profile case", e)
		}
		add(realOracleCase{Name: "profile-" + id, View: "profiles", Filter: f}, r)
	}
	for _, id := range accountIDs {
		f := base
		f.Account = id
		r, e := s.ProfileReport(ctx, f)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("account case", e)
		}
		add(realOracleCase{Name: "account-" + id, View: "profiles", Filter: f}, r)
	}
	for _, id := range keep("profile_proof", profileWindowIDs, realProfileProofCap) {
		p, e := s.ProfileProof(ctx, id, base)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("profile proof case", e)
		}
		add(realOracleCase{Name: "window-" + id, View: "profile-proof", Window: id, Filter: base}, p)
	}

	// Unfiltered history drives the history-proof window set.
	var historyWindowIDs []string
	for _, kind := range []string{"", "5h", "weekly"} {
		name := kind
		if name == "" {
			name = "all"
		}
		r, e := s.Report(ctx, "", kind, 0, 0, base.APIKey)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("history case", e)
		}
		if kind == "" {
			for _, w := range r.Windows {
				historyWindowIDs = append(historyWindowIDs, w.ID)
			}
		}
		add(realOracleCase{Name: "history-" + name, View: "history", Kind: kind, Filter: base}, r)
	}
	for _, id := range keep("history_proof", historyWindowIDs, realProofCap) {
		p, e := s.ProofAt(ctx, id, base.Through, base.ObservationsThrough, base.At, base.APIKey)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("history proof case", e)
		}
		add(realOracleCase{Name: "proof-" + id, View: "history-proof", Window: id, Filter: base}, p)
	}

	// Quota: current and history for the base pin, then history per capped account.
	for _, period := range []string{"current", "history"} {
		f := QuotaUsageFilter{ProfileFilter: base, Period: period}
		r, e := s.QuotaUsage(ctx, f)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("quota case", e)
		}
		add(realOracleCase{Name: "quota-" + period, View: "quota", Filter: base, Quota: &f}, r)
	}
	for _, id := range accountIDs {
		f := QuotaUsageFilter{ProfileFilter: base, Period: "history"}
		f.Account = id
		r, e := s.QuotaUsage(ctx, f)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("quota account case", e)
		}
		add(realOracleCase{Name: "quota-account-" + id, View: "quota", Filter: base, Quota: &f}, r)
	}

	// Forecast windows come from the stored forecast rows, the only source that
	// names every window with forecasts (not only those visible in a report).
	rows, e := s.db.QueryContext(ctx, `SELECT DISTINCT window_id FROM analytics_forecasts`)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	var forecastWindowIDs []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var id string
		if e = rows.Scan(&id); e != nil {
			rows.Close()
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		forecastWindowIDs = append(forecastWindowIDs, id)
	}
	if e = rows.Err(); e != nil {
		rows.Close()
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	rows.Close()
	for _, id := range keep("forecasts", forecastWindowIDs, realForecastCap) {
		ledger, e := s.forecastEvidence(ctx, id, base)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("forecast case", e)
		}
		add(realOracleCase{Name: "forecast-" + id, View: "forecasts", Window: id, Filter: base}, ledger)
	}

	raw, e := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "real-oracle.json"), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	counts := map[string]int{}
	for _, c := range cases {
		counts[c.View]++
	}
	meta, e := json.MarshalIndent(map[string]any{
		"source_commit": os.Getenv("PACER_REAL_SOURCE_SHA"),
		"pin":           base,
		"cases":         len(cases),
		"case_counts":   counts,
		"caps": map[string]int{
			"profiles":      realProfileCap,
			"accounts":      realAccountCap,
			"profile_proof": realProfileProofCap,
			"history_proof": realProofCap,
			"forecasts":     realForecastCap,
		},
		"coverage": coverage,
		"case_sources": map[string]string{
			"profiles":      "profile cards and credentials of the base profiles report",
			"profile_proof": "windows of the base profiles report",
			"history_proof": "windows of the unfiltered history report",
			"quota":         "current and history for base; history per capped account",
			"forecasts":     "distinct analytics_forecasts.window_id",
		},
	}, "", "  ")
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "real-boundary.json"), append(meta, '\n'), 0600); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Logf("%d original cases written", len(cases))
}
